assumptions: The committed src/retrieval/calibration.json is the genuine output of scripts/calibrate-tokenizer.mjs against a real ANTHROPIC_API_KEY — its numbers were not re-derived here, only validated for shape and range
A measured table still warrants conservative_fallback: true, because it is an empirical bound over a named corpus rather than a count
Breaking the packet token_usage shape (new table_provenance field) is acceptable on the v3 line, per the settled 'breaking behaviour is permitted on v3' decision

No network: the measured ratios could not be re-verified against the count-tokens API
context: Wired src/retrieval/calibration.json into the tokenizer: ACTIVE_TABLE (measured, validated at load, proven fallback) is now the default for every estimate, packet and briefing. 2711 pass.
rationale: Supersedes the D36 re-baseline that moved these to the proven 1-token-per-byte bound. Two of them had gone vacuous, which a scale-by-eye pass would have missed: test/context-assembler.test.ts's graph tie-break at 150 now fits TWO decisions, dropping the case into its tolerant else-branch so it stopped testing the tie-break at all (one-decision band measured at 40..70, set to 65); and test/acceptance/cases/c05.test.ts A13/A14 at 700 now fits both records whole, so it stopped testing incompleteness (set to 300, which reproduces the proven-700 shape exactly: nothing emitted, banner rendered). The rest: c26's 4000 -> TIGHT=1700 (same 3-of-5 emission, same manifest; emitted=3 band is 1600..1870), gap7's control 1600 -> 700 (degradation stops between 1600 and 2000, so 1600 had drifted to the edge of proving anything), overhead-measurement 800/400 -> 200/100 (the ORIGINAL chars/4-era thresholds, restored because measured actuals are 70.3 and 51). Every band was probed, not scaled; every site carries the 3-step chain (chars/4 -> proven -> measured) in a comment.
summary: Re-baselined SIX lane-04 budget/density baselines down to measured-table units, each to a MEASURED band rather than a scaled guess, restoring the pre-lane-04 numbers where the measured table brings them back
